name: Theodoretus Grammaticus
bio: Theodoretus Grammaticus is one of the named epigrammatists of the Greek Anthology. Paton’s Index of Authors gives no date for him.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 34.

poems.title: Book XVI, 34: On the Portrait of Philippus, Prefect of Smyrna
poems.author: Theodoretus Grammaticus
poems.text: This is the gift of Philadelphia to Philippus. Mark how well the city remembers his just rule.
